page.title: Rewards
page.description: Keep track of your gift card rewards and repeat bookings.

empty.title: No rewards yet
empty.body: Gift card rewards from qualifying bookings will appear here. Find a task to get started.

notHelper.title: Set up as a helper
notHelper.body: Rewards are for helpers. Finish your helper setup to find work and start making qualifying bookings.

repeat.title: Repeat progress
repeat.progress: {count, number} of {needed, plural, one {# paid booking} other {# paid bookings}} with {name} · by {date}
repeat.empty: No repeat progress to track right now. Qualifying paid bookings with the same client will appear here.

monthly.title: This month
monthly.description: The monthly limit covers all reward programs and resets each calendar month.

rules.title: How rewards work
rules.welcome: {amount} for your first qualifying booking of {threshold} or more as a founding helper.
rules.repeat: {amount} for your third paid booking with the same client within 90 days.
rules.repeatThreshold: Each qualifying booking must have a task price of {threshold} or more.
rules.hold: Rewards have a 7-day hold after the work is completed and paid. Welcome rewards also need a check from our team before you can redeem them.
rules.expiry: Redeem within 90 days of a reward becoming ready to redeem.
rules.giftCards: Rewards are gift cards, not earnings
rules.detailsInTerms: See the rewards terms for this program's qualifying bookings and reward amounts.

card.deliveryUnavailable: The gift card link isn't available yet. Refresh the page or contact support.

statusDetails.pending: Unlocks after the work is completed and paid
statusDetails.issuing: Your gift card is on its way
statusDetails.failed: Delivery failed. Support will reissue it
statusDetails.voided: This reward wasn't earned. Contact support if you need help.

statusFallbacks.qualified: Your reward is in its hold period
statusFallbacks.redeemable: Your reward is ready to redeem
statusFallbacks.expired: The time to redeem this reward has passed

voidReasons.booking_canceled: The booking was canceled, so this reward wasn't earned.
voidReasons.refunded: The booking was refunded, so this reward wasn't earned.
voidReasons.below_threshold: The final task price was below the amount needed for this reward.
voidReasons.risk_review: This reward didn't meet the program requirements. Contact support if you need help.

redeem.submitted: Your gift card is on its way
redeem.not_allowed: This reward is no longer available to redeem. Refresh the page to see its status.
redeem.rate_limited: There have been too many requests. Wait a moment before redeeming again.
redeem.unknown: We couldn't request your gift card. Try again, or contact support if it keeps happening.
